website.note: Corporate site centers on commercial RECELL platform; no pre-approval drug pipeline

ctgov.note: All 18 sponsored ctgov records are NA-phase device studies (post-market or supportive); none are P1/P2/P3 drug trials.

approved_devices.name: RECELL System
approved_devices.regulatory: FDA PMA approved Sep 2018 (acute thermal burns, adults); pediatric supplement Jun 2021; full-thickness skin defects Jun 2023; vitiligo (paused commercially) Jun 2023.

approved_devices.name: RECELL GO
approved_devices.regulatory: FDA PMA supplement approved May 29, 2024 for thermal burns and full-thickness skin defects; CE Mark Sep 2025.

approved_devices.name: RECELL GO mini
approved_devices.regulatory: FDA approved Dec 23, 2024 for smaller wounds (up to 480 cm^2).

approved_devices.name: Cohealyx
approved_devices.regulatory: FDA 510(k) clearance Dec 19, 2024; U.S. commercial launch Apr 1, 2025. Bovine collagen-based dermal matrix (Regenity partnership).

approved_devices.name: PermeaDerm
approved_devices.regulatory: FDA 510(k) cleared biosynthetic wound matrix; distributed under multi-year agreement with Stedical.

post_market_studies: Cohealyx 40-patient post-market study evaluating time-to-graft reduction in full-thickness wounds and burns
PermeaDerm ~40-patient post-market health-economic study vs human cadaveric allograft

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical device (Class III) company. All wound-care products (RECELL, RECELL GO, RECELL GO mini, Cohealyx, PermeaDerm) are FDA-approved or 510(k)-cleared and commercially launched; only post-market clinical studies are ongoing (no active pivotal IDE / PMA-supporting pre-approval studies disclosed). No drug candidates in P1/P2/P3.
